about: Brossard is on the South Shore of the St. Lawrence, immediately across from the Island of Montréal via the Champlain Bridge. It is a bilingual suburban city with a large immigrant population, including a well-known Chinese commercial strip, and is a major shopping and REM-transit node. Quartier DIX30 is a large outdoor lifestyle centre at the Autoroute 10 interchange. About 92,000 people live in Brossard.
